subject: Re: Sirocco status: decisions for the May 25 memo
body:
All,

Decisions for the Sirocco close-out memo:

1. We formally drop internal case two - one deep case study beats two shallow ones, and the reorg isn't our problem to wait out. The memo says so plainly.
2. Internal case one carries the recommendation: ICO held the contractual FPR budget on held-out data across all four monthly slices while cutting FNR ~6% relative. That's the number the screening team's leadership cares about.
3. Fumiko's sigmoid_temp tuning recipe (validate on constraint gap, not objective) goes in as required practice, boxed and bolded. Anyone adopting ICO without it will produce exactly the slack-constraint failures we're trying to eliminate.
4. Recommendation: ICO becomes the trust-theory-endorsed method for thresholded rate-metric training where constraint satisfaction is contractual; general rollout gets scoped as a Q3 proposal.

Thanks all - Sirocco lands on time on May 25.

Ximena
